cases.name: status follows runs and blocking asks
content outside a run changes the live state but no run items
blocks: deltas, authoritative finish, unknown ids and subagent blocks
tools: every update, nesting, and the call item completed at finish
a retraction removes the messages' blocks, calls and results, open or finished
a long run drops its oldest items, counts them, and a replacement starts afresh
open text and running output keep their newest characters within the cap
the cut drops a low surrogate at either edge of the range, and keeps what is outside it
settings: model, thinking, modes, queue, usage and plan are replaced
an activity is a run item only inside a run; background tasks are replaced whole
resynced replaces the state, and later events apply on top of it
